newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BRL says trading ok, small deals planned.
newsitem.headline: BRL says trading ok, small deals planned.

text.p: Australia's second largest wine producer BRL Hardy Ltd said on Thursday it had ruled out any major acquisitions in the near future but was close to completing two smaller deals.
"One within a month, if the other comes to fruition an announcement may be within a couple of months," managing director Stephen Millar said.
He also said the first three months of calendar 1997 had been very pleasing and the company was in line with analysts forecasts for double digit profit growth.
Asked about the impending deals, Millar would not say if they were direct acquisitions or joint ventures.
